purpose: Regression benchmark for Phase 02A: pixel hashes of sampled frames and the full MP4 of the v5 render (user-liked look). Refactors and engine changes must not change them unless the change is a deliberate, reviewed visual improvement (then re-baseline with evidence).
renderer: headless Chrome + SwiftShader (CHROME_ARGS in scripts/render_phase02a_visual.py), 1080x1920, 30 fps
note: v6 has NOT passed independent semantic review; the benchmark protects the look, it is not a quality approval.
rebaseline_reason: Deliberate visual improvements after the independent review of v5 (HARD_FAIL): AC fully framed and slumped/wiping Bima in S001, remote screen shows 28 -> 24, single thermometer, icy coil and lower framing in S003, compressor pumping, plume through the fan and indoor unit kept in frame in S004.
